observations: Image API supports state, q (filename/ID/SHA-256/tag), format, tag, source, visibility, gps, since/until, sort new/old/large/small/name, cursor pagination, and a facets endpoint.
PATCH accepts any non-empty subset of visibility, filename and tags; batch supports trash, restore, purge and visibility for up to 500 IDs.
Upload accepts an optional visibility part and returns duplicate=true for an existing image.
Error strings in web/src/lib/api.ts are reused for upload errors in the prototype.
inferences: Tags, rename, date-range and source filters were added to the backend after the prototype round; the approved prototype's extension toggle corresponds to shipped behaviour.
limitations: The earlier darkroom design was rejected and has been replaced in production; its layout and metaphor copy carry no authority.

sources.location: Style reference text pasted by the user in chat on 2026-10-22 (Linear, 'midnight precision instrument')
sources.licenseOrPermission: user-provided reference; token values and principles only, no code, assets or brand marks copied
observations: Near-black surface ladder (#08090a, #0f1011, #161718, #23252a) with hairline borders instead of shadows.
One acid-lime accent #e4f222 reserved for the single primary action; everything else neutral greys.
Inter Variable at weights 400/510/590 with tight negative tracking; radii 4 (badges), 6 (controls), 12 (cards), pill.
Compact density on a 4px grid; quiet line icons; product UI is the only visual texture.
inferences: Applied to an operational console, not to a marketing page: the hero, gradient floor, logo strip and large display type are not used.
A light theme is derived from the same structure because the user wants both themes polished equally.
limitations: The reference describes Linear's marketing site; app-console patterns are adapted, not copied.
No Linear logo, wordmark, product screenshots or copy may appear in the product.
The reference's Tailwind snippet is ignored; production stays plain CSS in Svelte.

sources.location: npm @radix-ui/colors@3.0.0 (gray, gray-alpha, lime, red, amber, green, black-alpha, white-alpha; light and dark)
sources.licenseOrPermission: MIT; colour values only, copied as CSS custom properties
observations: Twelve-step scales: 1-2 backgrounds, 3-5 component fills, 6-8 borders and focus, 9-10 solid fills, 11-12 text.
Lime 9 is a bright step that takes dark text; red 9 takes white text.
inferences: Lime 9 replaces the earlier #e4f222 accent as the fill of the single primary action, at the user's request that every colour be a Radix colour.
limitations: No Radix Themes components or CSS are used; only the scale values and their step semantics.

observations: Two woff2 subsets (latin 48 KB, latin-ext 74 KB) cover all Latin UI text, numbers and identifiers.
inferences: Chinese text falls back to system CJK fonts after Inter.
limitations: Only the upright variable axis is shipped; no italics.
